review_method: Independent target-blind pair review followed by labeled cleaned ordered-cell inspection; no real-time playback claim
warnings: Near-axis intermediate yaw or pitch differences are subtle at pet size, especially 022.5, 067.5, 112.5, 157.5, 202.5, 292.5 and 337.5; all have correct observed quadrant.

Raised chin and upward eyes retain upward pitch while nose and face move slightly screen-right.
Nose projects screen-right and raised visible eye/chin establish upward pitch.
Strong rightward nose profile combines with slightly raised chin and gaze.

Rightward nose profile remains clear while chin and visible gaze lower slightly.
Lowered eyes and chin indicate down while nose and face remain right of head center.

Broadly frontal head tucks chin toward chest and image bottom; crown is visible and eyes sit lowered beneath brows.
Bowed head and lowered eyes retain down pitch while nose and face bias slightly screen-left.
Tucked chin and downward gaze accompany a visible leftward nose and cheek turn.
Nose projects screen-left while head and eyes remain visibly lowered.
